items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: an American white woman got up in the audience and said, “You make me proud to be an American.”

ctx.x: What about the scene today? Do you think that there’s any — is the music still able to do that today or is there kind of two different—

Yeah they’re still able to do it. It still does what it can. I had occasion, I just came back from Paris a few weeks ago. And I was playing at a club over there in Paris. And in the middle of my concert, an American white woman got up in the audience and said, “You make me proud to be an American.” I thought that was very nice. So you see.
Gosh. You really reached her, didn’t you.
